purpose: PROJECT_RULES.md 5.4 auditor regression set: already-fixed, already-public KPanel vulnerabilities. Each case is reviewed blind on the parent of its fix with only the listed paths exported (git archive, no history).
scoring: A finding hits when it names the same function or data flow with the same failure mechanism; same file with a different mechanism does not count. A hit on another case's defect that also exists in the snapshot counts for that defect.

defects.summary: imported payload data roots not bound to their module, so a restore can replace an arbitrary host directory
audit rows not retained by count after migration replay
login history evicted under a full active window, resetting lockout counts
backup record roots bounded by an estimate instead of the encoded size
relayed node files forward the remote CSP and serve active types in the Panel origin
v1 summary-only pairing reaches file management; relay signature does not cover the inner method/path/query
AI auto approval writes cron, shell profiles, service hooks, .env and certificates without confirmation
password and username changes skip the shared re-authentication budget
passkey login shares the account password lockout; TOTP after a valid assertion has no own budget
file-manager chmod follows links and does not recheck the validated inode
AI/MCP file read secret-name check ignores backup suffixes and misses credential dotfiles
pending TOTP enrollment survives credential changes

baseline.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5, one fresh subagent per case, prompt as committed
baseline.cost: 5 reviewers in parallel, 68-243 s each (case-c 68 s after a resumed rate-limit stop), 121k-172k tokens each
baseline.sast: CodeQL 2.27.1 go/javascript security-extended, Semgrep 1.178.0 (golang/typescript/javascript/owasp-top-ten), gosec 2.29.0 on the same parents: 0 of 13 hits; current main raised 105 / 33 / 211 alerts
